devices.title: Where you're signed in
devices.description: Devices signed in to your account right now. If you don't recognise one, sign it out and change your password.
devices.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices
devices.signedOutOthers_one: {{count}} other device has been signed out.
devices.signedOutOthers_other: {{count}} other devices have been signed out.
devices.confirmTitle: Sign out of all other devices?
devices.confirmText_one: {{count}} other device will be signed out right away and will need your password to sign in again. You stay signed in here.
devices.confirmText_other: {{count}} other devices will be signed out right away and will need your password to sign in again. You stay signed in here.
devices.noActivity: No sign-ins in the last 90 days.
devices.noFailed: No failed sign-in attempts in the last 90 days.
devices.retention: Sign-in activity is kept for 90 days. We email you when a new device signs in.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.offValue: Off · We email you a code when you sign in on a new browser. Add an authenticator app for stronger protection.
twoFactor.offValueAdmin: Required for admins · You’ll set it up at your next sign-in.
twoFactor.setupLead: Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. Once it’s on, a new browser asks for a code from the app instead of an email.
twoFactor.scanTitle: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.scanText: In the app, choose “Add account”, then scan the code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.keyLabel: Can’t scan it? Enter this key instead:
twoFactor.codeTitle: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
twoFactor.saveCodes: Save your backup codes. If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. They won’t be shown again.
twoFactor.onLead: New browsers ask for a code from your authenticator app. Backup codes work if you don’t have your phone.
twoFactor.onLeadAdmin: Admins enter a code from the authenticator app at every sign-in. Backup codes work if you don’t have your phone.
twoFactor.backupFileTitle: EU Jobs backup codes (each works once)

password.description: Enter your current password, then the new one. You stay signed in on your other devices.

rules.title: Your new password
rules.email: Not the part of your email before the @
rules.common: Not a very common password. We check this when you save.

admin.title: Settings
admin.emailNote: Your sign-in email. It can’t be changed here.
admin.allClearText: Nothing is waiting for a review.

privacy.title: Choose how you’re discovered
privacy.description: Your resume isn’t shared just because your profile is visible.

discoverable.label: Profile visibility & recruiter discovery
discoverable.description: Allow recruiters to find your profile, listed skills and career preferences. Turn this off to keep your profile private. Companies you applied to still see your application.

resumeVisible.label: Resume visibility
resumeVisible.description: Allow recruiters who find your profile to open your live CV. Companies you applied to can always open the CV you sent.

matchingConsent.label: Matching consent
matchingConsent.description: Allow your profile to be used in AI matching. No protected characteristics are used.

privacy.note: Every download of your CV is logged.

layout.title: Your workspace. Your terms.
layout.description: Simple controls for your privacy, notifications, and personal information.

data.title: Understand and control your data
data.notice: Your account data is stored on EU Jobs servers. Download a copy whenever you like, or delete your account and personal data.

export.label: Download your data
export.description: A ZIP file with your records as JSON and the files you uploaded.

delete.label: Delete my data
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and personal data. Payment records are kept for accounting with your name removed.
delete.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your account, profile, CV versions, applications, messages, job alerts, learning progress, certificates and verification evidence. A Plus plan is cancelled at once, without a refund. Payment records are kept with your name removed. You will be signed out. This can’t be undone.
delete.password: Enter your current password to confirm.

deleteRecruiter.label: Delete account
deleteRecruiter.description: Close your jobs and permanently delete your account and personal data. Payment records are kept for accounting with your name removed.
deleteRecruiter.confirmBody: Your jobs are closed and your KYC documents, candidate notes, shortlist and activity are deleted. A {{plan}} plan is cancelled at once, without a refund. Candidates keep their applications and conversations under your company’s display name. Payment records are kept with your name removed. You will be signed out. This can’t be undone.
deleteRecruiter.password: Enter your current password to confirm.

review.title: Review EU Jobs
review.description: Tell other job seekers and recruiters what you think. After a quick check by our team, your review can appear on the EU Jobs home page with your first name and last initial.
review.saved: Thanks! Your review was sent for approval.

status.approved: Approved on {{date}} — shown on the home page
status.rejected: Not approved ({{date}}). You can edit it and send it again.
